action: Pinned-source audit of ClientInfo::default and ClientCapabilities::default at modelcontextprotocol/rust-sdk commit 4a738b9dd99eaca418b614afa433a0cbdaf8d056.
result: ClientInfo is an alias of InitializeRequestParams and its explicit Default implementation sets capabilities to ClientCapabilities::default(). ClientCapabilities derives Default and its sampling field is Option<SamplingCapability> with skip_serializing_if=Option::is_none. Therefore, within the inspected pinned source, ClientInfo::default() has sampling=None and the default serialized client capabilities do not advertise sampling.
source_scope: Own open_source LATEST r250, sanitized controls frozen at note main d685df2c0c375f19b85cce7e63bcc97dc271c8a5, own role config, and the two named pinned public rust-sdk files only.
scope_guard: This establishes only the default capability object at the pinned commit. It does not establish explicit opt-in builder behavior, alternate ClientInfo construction paths, negotiated server behavior, or end-to-end scheduled-Chat parity.
remaining_unresolved_child: Verify the explicit opt-in path that turns sampling on, without broadening to end-to-end behavior.
exact_continuation: Next invocation: preserve CLEAN bootstrap and exact SHA freeze. Stay pinned to modelcontextprotocol/rust-sdk commit 4a738b9dd99eaca418b614afa433a0cbdaf8d056.
